task: F4 Scope fidelity — Must NOT have violations absent
summary: All 12 Must NOT have guardrails PASS (absent or correctly guarded). No S3/minio, no host Postgres, no Alembic, no scapy fallback removal, no sharding/RBAC crowding, no theme restyle (TOK #1F7A4D/#E7F5EC/#F6F8F7/Inter/JetBrains preserved), no fallback when ready (health.postgres guard), no CONCURRENTLY in tx, no missing UNIQUE for CONCURRENTLY refresh, no TOAST rewrite without IS DISTINCT FROM, no lexical TEXT sort (lpad numeric).
